# M3 Benchmark Fixtures

Canonical-format experiment groups for the M3 benchmark scenarios. Each
primary scenario uses ten paired seeds. The fixtures are generated by
[`generate_fixtures.py`](generate_fixtures.py); edit the generator and rerun it
rather than editing the JSON by hand.

```bash
.venv/bin/python tests/fixtures/benchmarks/generate_fixtures.py
```

The expected evidence for every scenario is asserted in
[`tests/integration/test_benchmark_scenarios.py`](../../integration/test_benchmark_scenarios.py)
against an exact `Fraction` reference calculated from the designs below.

## Shared design

* Baseline `val_f1` per seed 1–10:
  `0.800, 0.805, 0.795, 0.810, 0.790, 0.800, 0.805, 0.795, 0.802, 0.798`.
* Candidate `val_f1` = baseline + designed improvement (units of `1e-3`).
* Baseline config: `lr=0.001`, `optimizer=adam`, `dataset=imagenet-v1`,
  `code_revision=a1b2c3d`, `augmentation=none`. Unless stated otherwise the
  candidate differs only by the treatment `augmentation=mixup`.

## Scenarios

| Fixture | Design (improvement × 1e-3, seeds 1–10) | Expected evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stable-small-improvement` | `12, 9, 11, 10, 8, 14, 10, 9, 11, 7` | mean `+10.1e-3`, median `10e-3`, positive 10/10, CI lower bound > 0, largest leave-one-out influence seed 6 |
| `stable-regression` | `-9, -11, -10, -12, -8, -10, -9, -13, -11, -10` | mean `-10.3e-3`, positive 0/10, CI upper bound < 0, negative `d_z`, largest influence seed 8 |
| `single-seed-dominated` | `1, -1, 0, 2, -2, 1, -1, 0, 1, 40` | mean `4.1e-3` vs median `0.5e-3` (mean − median `3.6e-3`), positive 5/10, largest influence seed 10 with leave-one-out mean `1/9 × 1e-3` |
| `increased-variance` | `30, -30, 25, -25, 20, -20, 36, -35, 10, -10` | mean `0.1e-3` (approximately unchanged), sample SD ≈ `27.0e-3`, CI spans 0, positive 5/10, largest influence seed 7 |
| `missing-paired-runs` | stable design; candidate seeds 4 and 9 absent | strict comparison fails and names `missing candidate seeds: [4, 9]` |
| `checkpoint-dependent` (final) | `val_loss` history, lower is better; final step 30: baseline `0.40 + 0.001s`, candidate `0.43 + 0.002s` | final policy: improvement `-30 - s`, positive 0/10, CI upper bound < 0, steps (30, 30) |
| `checkpoint-dependent` (best) | same history; candidate minimum `0.33 + 0.002s` at step 20 | best policy: improvement `70 - s`, positive 10/10, steps (30, 20), optimistic-selection limitation present |
| `conflicting-metrics` | stable `val_f1`; `latency_ms` improvements (× 1e-3 ms) `-2000, -1500, -2500, 500, -2000, -3000, -1500, -2000, -2500, -1000` | `direction_conflict` true; latency mean `-1.75` ms; 9 opposing pairs (seed 4 agrees) |
| `incompatible-config` | stable design; candidate also uses `dataset=imagenet-v2` | evidence is still calculated; config differences `augmentation`, `dataset` on all 10 pairs; no compatibility verdict |
| `confounded-change` | stable design; candidate changes `code_revision` and `optimizer` instead of `augmentation` | config differences `code_revision`, `optimizer` on all 10 pairs; no causal attribution field |

## Known limitations

* Paired evidence measures the spread of paired improvements, not each
  variant's own variance; `increased-variance` is therefore visible as a large
  improvement SD and a CI spanning zero, not as a variance ratio.
* Config differences cover top-level `RunConfig.values` keys only; nested
  differences are reported as a whole-value difference and `source_metadata`
  is not compared.
